Test_Description: Validates GPIO register default reset values and performs write-read verification across GPIO registers GP0_GPIO_8 through GP0_GPIO_27 using multiple data patterns
Notes: Uses read_mask_array and write_mask_array for selective register access; skip_array and skip_rst_array for register exclusion; default value check masks LSB with 0xFFFFFFFE

Test_Description: Tests GPIO negative edge interrupt enable functionality for all 32 pads. Configures each pad for negedge interrupt detection; drives signal high then low to trigger interrupt; verifies IRQ handler fires; checks interrupt status and clears interrupt
Registers_Under_Test: MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 to GP0_GPIO_39; MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1; MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1; MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1; MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1; MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1
Pass_Criteria: test_err == 0 => finish(0); All 32 pad interrupts fire within timeout
Fail_Criteria: test_err > 0 => finish(test_err); Timeout waiting for interrupt; Interrupt status mismatch; Group interrupt clear failure
Test_Patterns: Per-pad sequential: wr_val = 1 << i for i=0..31
Interrupt_Clear_Method: Write to INTR_RAW_STCLR1; Disable negedge bit in pad register; Clear via SYSREG_RAW_STCR1; GIC_ClearIRQ
Notes: Configures pad with bits[20;18;16] = interrupt_en|negedge_en|iclr; Drives external signal via address 0xA0243ffc; Timeout of 5000 iterations per pad; Supports GPIO0 and GPIO1 via conditional compilation

Test_Description: Tests GPIO positive edge interrupt enable functionality for all 32 pads simultaneously. Configures all pads for posedge interrupt; sets IO control groups for input mode; enables group interrupt; drives rising edge to trigger interrupt; verifies group interrupt status and clears all per-pin interrupts
Registers_Under_Test: MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 to GP0_GPIO_39; MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1; MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1; MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP1 to GROUP4; MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1; MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1
Pass_Criteria: test_err == 0 => finish(0); All 32 pad group interrupts fire within timeout
Fail_Criteria: test_err > 0 => finish(test_err); Timeout waiting for GPIO IRQ; Group interrupt not occurred; Group interrupt clear failed; Sysreg status not cleared
Test_Patterns: All pads enabled simultaneously: INTR_EN1 = 0xFFFFFFFF; Rising edge via 0x00000000 -> 0xFFFFFFFF
Interrupt_Clear_Method: Write iclr bit (bit16) to each pad register; Clear via SYSREG_RAW_STCR1; GIC_ClearIRQ; Re-enable group interrupt after clear
IO_Control_Groups: GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP1=0xFF; GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP2=0xFF; GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP3=0xFF; GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP4=0xFF (input mode doe=1)
Notes: Configures pad with bit[17] = posedge_en (0x00020000); Uses IO_CTRL_GROUP registers for input mode; Drives external signal via address 0xA0243ffc; Timeout of 2000 iterations per pad; Group interrupt enabled for all 32 pads; Supports GPIO0 and GPIO1 via conditional compilation
